title: Redirect via Redirect::to(payload) (rust) — review required
description: The rust call Redirect::to(payload) redirects to a computed address. Untrusted input enables phishing. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer validates targets via a same-origin check.
remediation: Validate targets with a same-origin check.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Redirect::to(payload) call matches.
